description:
IFStruct v1.0
	



[!Note]
📝 Blog post: https://www.liquid.ai/blog/ifstruct-v1.0
💻 GitHub: https://github.com/Liquid4All/ifstruct

IFStruct is a benchmark for structured-output compliance: can a model produce valid JSON/YAML that follows a requested schema, when the requirements are phrased the many different ways real users phrase them?
